context.revision_rule: Latest received full row edition at decision; same-receipt disagreement is missing. Preserve every raw version and first successful local receipt per full revision hash. No later settled edition repairs an earlier decision.

nbh.future_values: D and D+1 only; remaining slots null
nbh.original_blend_value: Lead3 target TMP, no model calls in this acquisition
nbh.revision_rule: Retain both scheduled original-cycle responses. Select latest complete valid receipt no later than decision, never another cycle. If the latest complete edition is missing a required value, retain missingness rather than select an older favorable edition.
nbh.availability: actual full local receipt<=decision AND runtime<=LastModified<=receipt; LastModified is storage metadata, not receipt proof

missed_deadline: Keep the eight-case calendar. No rolling start/targets or backdated receipt. Root must approve a new declaration before any later cohort.
